import sys
from collections import Counter

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
s = input[1]
b = list(map(int, input[2:]))

count = Counter(s)
max_beauty = 0

for i in range(n // 2):
    if count[s[i]] > 0 and count[s[n - i - 1]] > 0 and s[i] != s[n - i - 1]:
        max_beauty += b[i] + b[n - i - 1]
        count[s[i]] -= 1
        count[s[n - i - 1]] -= 1
    elif count[s[i]] > 1:
        max_beauty += b[i]
        count[s[i]] -= 2

print(max_beauty)
